inclusion_criteria: individuals ≥35 years of age, confirmed diagnosis of T2DM for a period of over 3 years, generalized severe chronic periodontitis (number of probing pocket depth [PPD] sites ≥30%, clinical attachment level [CAL] >4 mm, and bleeding on probing), and ≥15 teeth
exclusion_criteria: Pregnant women, smokers, patients with body mass index (BMI) >35 kg/m², or those who had received periodontal therapy, systemic antibiotic, or oral antiseptic therapy 6 months prior to the study were excluded.

inclusion_criteria: had been diagnosed with type 2 DM; had a baseline HbA1c ≥ 6.5%, had at least 10 teeth in the functional dentition (excluding third molars); and had a clinical diagnosis of periodontal disease with at least one site with a Probing Depth (PD) ≥ 5 mm, two teeth with attachment loss ≥ 6 mm and no modification in the pharmacological treatment of diabetes during the study period
exclusion_criteria: pregnancy or lactation, major diabetic complications, and the use of antibiotic therapy or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug therapy within 4 months before the first visit
n_evaluated: 100 T2DM at 3 mths (50 per arm), 60 non-diabetic at 3 mths (30 per arm)

inclusion_criteria: Confirmed diagnosis of Type 2 diabetes mellitus for >1 year, no change in diabetic treatment plan in the previous 2 months, no major diabetic complication such as coronary heart disease, clinical diagnosis of chronic periodontitis with ≥1 mm mean clinical attachment loss (including slight, moderate, and severe periodontitis), ≥16 teeth.
exclusion_criteria: 1) presence of a systemic disease other than diabetes that could influence the course of the periodontal disease; 2) systemic antibiotic administration within the previous 3 months; 3) pregnancy or lactation; 4) refusal to provide written informed consent; active infection other than periodontitis; received periodontal treatment in the previous 12 months.
n_evaluated: 126 at 6 months (42 in group 1, 43 in group 2, 41 in control)

inclusion_criteria: type 2 diabetes (using WHO diagnostic criteria) for 6 months or longer, moderate-to-severe periodontitis (≥20 periodontal pockets with probing pocket depths of >4 mm and marginal alveolar bone loss of >30%), and at least 15 teeth
exclusion_criteria: uncontrolled systemic diseases other than diabetes (cardiovascular diseases [including hypertension], liver diseases, pulmonary diseases, end-stage renal failure, or neoplasm); hepatitis B or HIV infection; chronic treatment (>2 weeks) with drugs known to affect periodontal tissues (phenytoin or ciclosporin); chronic systemic antibiotic treatment; and pregnancy or lactation
duration_since_diabetes_dx: ≥6 months; mean 8.3 (7.4) years in IPT, 8.7 (8.4) years in CPT
tobacco_use: Never: 75 (56%) IPT, 70 (53%) CPT; Current: 18 (14%) IPT, 19 (15%) CPT; Former: 40 (30%) IPT, 42 (32%) CPT
n_evaluated: 264 at baseline (ITT); 244 at 12 months (per-protocol: 121 IPT, 123 CPT)

inclusion_criteria: Subjects with type 2 DM; Diabetics presented with moderate to severe periodontitis (where 30% or more of the teeth have ≥4 mm clinical attachment loss); Subjects ≥30 years of age regardless of gender; Subjects with no evidence of other oral and systemic diseases; Subjects under treatment of an endocrinologist.
exclusion_criteria: Subjects with uncontrolled DM; Subjects who have undergone periodontal therapy during last 6 months; Subjects administered antibiotic during last 3 months; Subjects with <20 natural teeth; Subjects allergic to tetracycline and its derivatives; Pregnant and lactating mothers; Persons consuming any form of tobacco.

inclusion_criteria: Diagnosis of diabetes type 2 for more than 5 years; Type 2 diabetes with HbA1c level from 7% to 9% at the last medical evaluation; Age from 40 to 70 years; No change in diabetes treatment over the previous 3 months; Minimum sixth permanent teeth excluding third molars; Clinical attachment level (CAL) and pocket depth (PD) ≥4 mm in more than thirty percent of the sites; Diagnosis with chronic periodontitis; Diagnosis of periodontitis based on the presence of 4 teeth as a minimum with at least one site with a CAL ≥3 mm and PPD ≥4 mm.
exclusion_criteria: Pregnancy; Alcoholism and smoking; Presence of any systemic disorders other than hypertension and diabetes; Diabetic major complications; Antimicrobial therapies in the last 6 months; Periodontal therapies in the last 6 months; Allergy to metronidazole and amoxicillin.

inclusion_criteria: non-smokers, at least 18 years old, diagnosed with T2DM, Hispanic origin, dental treatment no less than 1 year ago, no systemic antibiotic therapy within 6 months of recruitment, and presence of localized or generalized severe chronic periodontitis according to the American Academy of Periodontology (AAP) criteria. HbA1c levels for inclusion in the study equalled ≥6.5%. Subjects with initial HbA1c values between 5.7–6.5% were included if they were taking hypoglycaemic medications.
exclusion_criteria: NR

inclusion_criteria: Men and women 35 years and older; physician-diagnosed type 2 diabetes of more than 3 months' duration; HbA1c value between 7.0% and less than 9.0% at screening; no changes in diabetes medications within the last 3 months; in the care of a physician for their diabetes; agreed to not change diabetes medications during the trial unless medically indicated; agreed to avoid pregnancy during the trial; diagnosis of moderate to advanced chronic periodontitis (clinical attachment loss and probing depth of at least 5 mm in 2 or more quadrants); minimum of 16 natural teeth; no periodontal treatment in the prior 6 months; radiographs confirming chronic periodontitis.
exclusion_criteria: Participants needing treatment of extensive tooth decay, tooth abscesses, or other oral infection (e.g., teeth needing root canal therapy); limited life expectancy; diabetes-related emergency within 30 days; use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs other than daily low-dose aspirin (75–325 mg); use of immunosuppressive medications; antibiotic use (>7 days within 30 days of enrollment); dialysis; risk of bleeding complications; heavy alcohol consumption (>3 drinks/d for men and >2 drinks/d for women).
duration_since_diabetes_dx: mean 12.3 (SD 8.2) years in treatment group; mean 11.3 (SD 8.4) years in control group
tobacco_use: Current smokers included; Treatment: never 50.2%, former 34.6%, current 15.2%; Control: never 56.0%, former 33.5%, current 10.5%
alcohol_consumption: Heavy alcohol consumption excluded (>3 drinks/d for men and >2 drinks/d for women)
n_evaluated: 476 completed the study (240 treatment, 236 control); primary analysis n=257 per group at 6 months

inclusion_criteria: HbA1c ≥8.5%, used VA outpatient care, willing to participate in a 12–16-month study, had at least eight teeth, and had sufficient periodontal treatment need as indicated by CPITN scores of ≥3 in at least two sextants.
exclusion_criteria: Malignancy, immune compromise (e.g. post-organ transplant, HIV), or poor health. Veterans were also excluded if there was exudate on probing or palpation until acute infection was eliminated.
tobacco_use: Current smokers: 24% overall (19% Usual Care, 29% Early Treatment); former: 54%; never: 22%
alcohol_consumption: Drinks per week: mean 1.8 (SD 5); Usual Care 1.43, Early Treatment 2.2

inclusion_criteria: Aboriginal Australian participants aged 18 years or older without a previous history of cardiovascular disease, a minimum of five natural teeth and moderate/severe periodontitis defined using the joint Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and American Academy of Periodontology case definition.
exclusion_criteria: Individuals receiving periodontal treatment in the preceding 6 months, those with cardiovascular disease history, rheumatic fever or any other medical condition requiring preventive antibiotic prophylaxis, pregnant women, or people with clinically visible endodontic or orofacial infections.
tobacco_use: Current smokers enrolled; smoking data available for 50 participants at baseline

inclusion_criteria: age of 39–75 years, HbA1c 6.5–10.0%, without severe diabetic complications, no evidence of systemic diseases other than diabetes as a risk factor for periodontitis, no systemic antibiotics during the preceding 3 months, no pregnancy or lactation, no allergy to tetracycline, no smoking, and no modifications in the treatment of diabetes during the preceding 2 months; at least 11 remaining teeth, at least two pocket sites with probing depth 4 mm or more (indicated as mild to severe periodontitis), no periodontal treatment during the preceding 6 months.
exclusion_criteria: severe diabetic complications, systemic diseases other than diabetes as a risk factor for periodontitis, systemic antibiotics during the preceding 3 months, pregnancy or lactation, allergy to tetracycline, smoking, modifications in the treatment of diabetes during the preceding 2 months, fewer than 11 remaining teeth, no pocket sites with probing depth ≥4 mm, periodontal treatment during the preceding 6 months.
duration_since_diabetes_dx: Mean ± S.D. (median) [range]: Intervention 11.3 ± 6.4 (6) [3–25] years; Control 8.8 ± 7.5 (9.0) [1–30] years

inclusion_criteria: (1) patients with type 2 DM with glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) values: 6%–8%; (2) creatinine values <1.4 mg/dl; (3) liver function tests were not up to three times the normal range; (4) no major diabetic complications; (5) no history of systemic antibiotic administration within the last 3 months; (6) no periodontal treatment 6 months prior to the study.
exclusion_criteria: NR
duration_since_diabetes_dx: Treatment group: mean 9.32 ± 8.36 years; Control group: mean 8.05 ± 5.90 years
tobacco_use: Five patients in the treatment and two patients in the control group were smokers.

inclusion_criteria: Age 45-60 years, presence of ≥12 teeth (excluding third molars), no change in medication use during the 2 months before or during the study, clinical diagnosis of moderate or severe generalized chronic periodontitis, receiving treatment for at least 1 year after a diagnosis of T2DM.
exclusion_criteria: Cardiovascular disease, chronic respiratory disease, rheumatoid arthritis, or any other systemic disease that could influence periodontal disease; pregnant or lactating; current or ex-smokers; major diabetic complications; history of systemic antibiotic use within the previous 3 months; periodontal treatment during the previous 6 months.
n_evaluated: 125 at 6 months (100 T2DM + 25 nondiabetic, with 9 lost to follow-up included via intention-to-treat)

inclusion_criteria: 1) teeth with sites with a PD >5 mm and attachment loss in at least 2 quadrants; 2) BOP at these sites; 3) at least 20 remaining teeth; 4) a HbA1c level ≥6.5%; and 5) non-smoking status. Additionally, all patients were diagnosed with periodontitis.
exclusion_criteria: 1) current abuse of alcohol or drugs; 2) chronic liver disease including hepatitis; and 3) a body mass index (BMI) ≥40 kg/m².
alcohol_consumption: excluded if current abuse of alcohol or drugs

inclusion_criteria: Type 2 DM, aged 40–75 years, A1C levels ranging from 7% to 10%, having at least 16 teeth present, at least eight sites with probing pocket depth (PPD) ≥6 mm and four sites with clinical attachment loss ≥5 mm, distributed in at least two different quadrants
exclusion_criteria: History of systemic antibiotic usage over the previous 3 months; non-surgical periodontal treatment during the previous 6 months; surgical periodontal treatment over the previous 12 months; current medication usage of calcium channel blockers, phenytoin, or cyclosporine; history of stroke or an acute cardiovascular event over the previous 12 months; renal (creatinine >1.5 mg/dl) or liver dysfunction (AST/ALT levels >2.5 times ULN)

inclusion_criteria: type 2 diabetes (diagnosed at least 1.5 years prior the study) and generalized chronic periodontitis (Armitage, 1999) at least nine teeth present and >30% of the probed gingiva with a depth and clinical attachment level ≥4 mm
exclusion_criteria: antibiotic treatment during the previous 15 days or for periods >10 days during the last 3 months, non-surgical periodontal treatment within the past 6 months, pregnancy, significant changes in diabetes medication during the course of the study, and evidence of other serious systemic disease (ASA III or IV)
duration_since_diabetes_dx: diagnosed at least 1.5 years prior the study; median duration CG 11 (IQR 12) years, TG 10 (IQR 10) years
tobacco_use: Smoking reported; CG: 93.8% non-smokers, 6.3% current/former; TG: 64.3% non-smokers, 35.7% current smokers

inclusion_criteria: Men and women (≥30 years) with physician-diagnosed T2DM (diagnosed at least 2 months prior to the study), able to make hospital visits throughout the trial, in the care of a physician for their diabetes, agreed to not change their diabetes medications during the trial unless medically indicated; diagnosis of mild to advanced chronic periodontitis defined as ≥2 interproximal sites with CAL ≥3 mm and ≥2 interproximal sites with PPD ≥4 mm (not on the same tooth) or one site with PPD ≥5 mm.
exclusion_criteria: Pregnancy, inappropriate status for the trials such as limited life expectancy and diabetes-related emergency, and receiving periodontal treatment in the prior 6 months.
duration_since_diabetes_dx: at least 2 months prior to the study
tobacco_use: Smoker (person): 5 (29.4%) in control group, 2 (10.0%) in periodontal treatment group
alcohol_consumption: Drinker (person): 7 (41.2%) in control group, 7 (35.0%) in periodontal treatment group

inclusion_criteria: presence of moderate to advanced chronic periodontitis, with at least 12 teeth present and with 5 or more pockets of 5 mm or more and probing attachment loss of 4 mm or more in at least 2 different quadrants which bled on probing
exclusion_criteria: a history of systemic antibiotic usage over the previous 4 months, having received non-surgical periodontal treatment within the past 6 months or surgical periodontal treatment within the past 12 months; pregnancy, change of medication for diabetes during the course of the study, current smokers or history of a cerebrovascular or cardiovascular event within the past 12 months
duration_since_diabetes_dx: diagnosed at least 1 year prior to the study

inclusion_criteria: Patients aged above 30 years of either sex, with type 2 DM; Absence of any major diabetic complications; Moderate to advanced periodontitis (30% or more of the teeth examined having ≥4 mm probing depth); No evidence of any systemic disease other than diabetes being a risk factor for periodontitis.
exclusion_criteria: Patients with uncontrolled DM; Patients who have undergone periodontal treatment in the 6 month period prior to the study; History of antibiotic administration within the last 3 months; Less than 16 remaining natural teeth.

inclusion_criteria: Age 35–65 years; at least 16 natural teeth; moderate to severe periodontitis; HbA1c level ≥6.5% and <14% at baseline; already diagnosed T2DM since ≥1 year; ≥2 interproximal sites having ≥5 mm PPD or ≥4 mm of clinical attachment loss; patients under either or both kind of diabetes management (insulin and/or oral glycemic therapy)
exclusion_criteria: Type-1 DM; HbA1c ≤6.5%/pre-diabetic; Type-2 DM <1 year; HbA1c ≥14%; pacemaker; life-threatening condition; on high-dose NSAIDs; physical/mental disability; did not consent; no periodontitis on examination; <16 teeth
tobacco_use: Smoking: No: 47/46/43; Yes: 2/2/4 (in three arms respectively)

inclusion_criteria: Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes; diabetes therapy had remained unchanged over the previous 3 months; had not participated in DM educational programs prior to commencement of study; diagnosis of periodontitis within the previous 3 years.
exclusion_criteria: Insulin dependent diabetes mellitus; higher chronic disease; smoking or consuming alcohol; used any antibiotics or long-term anti-inflammatory drugs in the last 6 months prior to the trial; females who are pregnant, lactating or less than 6 weeks post-partum; received periodontal treatment within the previous year; unable to provide informed consent or comply with study requirements; younger than 18 years.
n_evaluated: 90 at 6 mths (intervention group), 90 at 6 mths (control group)

inclusion_criteria: patients with DM2, blood sugar controlled only with oral hypoglycemic agents, mild to moderate periodontitis (pocket depth of 4–5 mm), presence of a minimum of 28 teeth, and no systemic antibiotic administration and no periodontal treatment in last six months
exclusion_criteria: patients with systemic diseases other than DM2, tobacco and alcohol users, and patients suffering from oral disease who needed emergency treatment

inclusion_criteria: 1) patients diagnosed with T2DM over one year; 2) patients with moderately poor glycemic control (HbA1c between 7.5% and 9.5%); 3) not older than 70 years; BMI between 19 kg/m² and 26 kg/m² in women, BMI between 20 kg/m² and 27 kg/m² in men; 4) no medication changes during the 3 months of study; 5) not smoking; 6) without severe complications, such as diabetic nephropathy, stroke, angina, myocardial infarction. Periodontitis criteria: 1) with over 20 teeth, PD over 5 mm, more than 30% teeth with AL over 4 mm, or over 60% teeth with PD >4 mm and AL >3 mm; 2) without periodontal treatment in the previous 6 months; 3) without antibiotics or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs administered in the last 3 months; 4) without serious systemic diseases or complications.
exclusion_criteria: Patients with systemic inflammatory diseases (rheumatoid arthritis, etc.), blood disease, liver damage, kidney disease or trauma were excluded.
n_evaluated: 157 at 3 months (75 in T2DM-NT group, 82 in T2DM-T group)

inclusion_criteria: poorly controlled T2D patients with moderate to severe chronic periodontitis according to the 2012 CDC-AAP classification, and having at least eleven teeth (> 11 teeth) in the mouth
exclusion_criteria: received periodontal treatment (scaling and root planning) or experimented any alteration of the diabetes treatment six months prior to the study; onset of systemic diseases or an acute condition; use of immunosuppressive medications or others drugs or presence of conditions able to alter periodontitis clinical features (pregnant women, alcohol users, smokers and acute anemia)

inclusion_criteria: Diagnosed with type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus at least 1 year before inclusion; uncontrolled on the date of inclusion (HbA1c between 7.0% and 9.5%); diabetes treatment unchanged over the previous 3 months; at least six permanent natural teeth; diagnosis of periodontitis with at least four teeth with at least one probed site with PPD ≥4 mm and CAL ≥3 mm.
exclusion_criteria: HbA1c not in inclusion range; allergies to antibiotics; too high dental mobility; anti-thrombotic agents; no periodontitis; insufficient number of teeth; declined to participate; not available for follow-up.
duration_since_diabetes_dx: Type 1: control 25.2 ± 11.0 yrs, treatment 25.0 ± 13.9 yrs; Type 2: control 19.9 ± 13.0 yrs, treatment 18.1 ± 11.2 yrs
tobacco_use: Smokers present: Type 1 control 8 (24%), treatment 7 (23%); Type 2 control 0 (0%), treatment 2 (15%)
n_evaluated: 88 at 3 months (ITT: 44 control + 44 treatment for HbA1c); 76 per protocol (42 control + 34 treatment)

inclusion_criteria: 1) patients with a diagnosis of T2DM for over one year by a grade three hospital who volunteered for the research; 2) 6.50 ≤ HbA1c% ≤ 10.00; 3) chronic periodontitis, ≥15 remaining teeth, and more than 30% of teeth with probing depths (PDs) ≥5 mm and attachment loss (AL) >4 mm, or more than 60% of teeth with a PD >4 mm and an AL ≥3 mm; 4) a body mass index (BMI) <30 kg/m²; 5) without periodontal treatment in the previous 6 months; 6) without antibiotic or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug administration in the 3 months; and 7) without serious systemic diseases or complications.
exclusion_criteria: NR
tobacco_use: Smokers included; intervention group: 6 (31.58%) Yes, 13 (68.42%) No; control group: 3 (15.00%) Yes, 17 (75.00%) No
alcohol_consumption: Intervention group: No 12 (61.15%), Seldom 3 (15.79%), Often 4 (21.06%); Control group: No 17 (75.00%), Seldom 2 (10.00%), Often 1 (5.00%)

inclusion_criteria: (i) clinical diagnosis of DM for at least 5 years with HbA1c level more than 6.5%; (ii) consistent anti-diabetic treatment 3 months prior to the study; (iii) at least 40 years old; over six sites with probing depth (PD) ≥ 4 mm and over 25% of sites with interproximal clinical attachment loss (CAL) ≥ 5 mm as well as at least 10 teeth present.
exclusion_criteria: Patients with documented history of CVD were excluded. Patients with antibiotic/anti-inflammatory treatment within three months prior to the study or those requiring antibiotic prophylaxis were excluded.
tobacco_use: Smoking status was recorded, but smokers were not excluded; Treatment group 9.1% smokers, Control group 14.3% smokers.

inclusion_criteria: (1) no history of another major illness and no antibiotics or other medications received for at least three previous months; (2) at least 14 standing teeth, pocket probing depth was ≥5 mm, but <8 mm in at least one site in 4 teeth in at least 2 different quadrants; (3) bleeding and/or suppuration on probing; (4) no periodontal treatment for 6 months prior to baseline examination; (5) female subjects should not be pregnant or breast-feeding.
exclusion_criteria: NR

inclusion_criteria: T2DM for more than 1 year; diagnosis of T2DM meeting at least one of: (1) postprandial plasma glucose ≥200 mg/dL; (2) FPG ≥126 mg/dL; (3) 2-hour oral glucose tolerance test ≥200 mg/dL; (1) 35 to 80 years old; (2) at least 16 natural teeth; (3) at least four teeth with PPD ≥5 mm, CAL ≥4 mm, and BOP in two or more oral quadrants; (4) HbA1c level within 3 months before recruitment at least 5.5%
exclusion_criteria: (1) accompanied with other systemic immune diseases; (2) administered with antibiotics, immunomodulators, contraceptives, or any other form of hormone within the past 3 months; (3) underwent modified diabetes treatment strategy within 3 months; (4) had periodontal treatment within the past 12 months; (5) needed extraction or endodontic treatment; (6) smokes more than four cigarettes per day; (6) pregnant or lactating women
tobacco_use: smokes more than four cigarettes per day (excluded); 12 smokers in treatment group, 6 in control group enrolled
alcohol_consumption: 13 in treatment group, 7 in control group
n_evaluated: 71 at 3 months; 72 at 6 months (49 treatment + 23 control at 3 months; 49 sub-groups + 22 control at 6 months)
